description: Reservas de Hidrocarburos al 1 de enero de cada año (2024) is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía (SENER). Conjunto de datos que representan el volumen de las reservas de petróleo crudo, condensados y gas natural al primer día de cada año. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía (SENER). Its tags are combustible, explotación hidrocarburos, gas natural, gasolineras, hidrocarburo. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-04-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
